email.subject: Harbor Auto Care's site on mobile
email.body:
Hi Elena,

I checked Harbor Auto Care's website. Two things are likely costing you customers: the site isn't set up for mobile, and there's no tap-to-call button. Most people searching for an auto shop are on their phone, often right when their car's giving them trouble, and if the page doesn't work well or they can't tap to call, they just call the next shop on the list instead. The page is also slow to load due to large images, which makes it worse.

I fix exactly this kind of thing for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you what's happening and what I'd do?

Alex
Northlight Web
